approach: Transit approach: this slice is every station on the record this cycle, what moved against last cycle, and the transit workers on the roster. The week header (weather, home games, the union of causes), the chaos car on the line and the citizens who lived a transit line are record; the Factors on each station row are the engine's own causes — the frame at their head (weather; weekend; holiday: <name> (major) or (no cut)) is the citywide day-type cut, and the rest are the row's own reasons (holiday lift in its hood, First Friday, game day, events, a stalled train, a short crew, crowded platforms). Riders rise and fall for the reasons written there, never for a reason you add. A BART-train chaos hit this cycle reaches the platforms NEXT cycle. Dry, technical, timestamp and pattern — but it is a place with people in it. One system, one claim about what changed. Facts on this slice: the names, places, roles and numbers listed. Those are real; do not invent people or places. Everything else about this beat — what it looks like, who is there, what they want and hate — is yours to paint.

hooks.text: Story seed 08156f4b (Fruitvale): Rose Delgado, Lillian Gebre, Ramon Solano, Mateus Albuquerque — Rose Delgado — felt quietly proud of how they handled something small; Lillian Gebre — navigated the stroller traffic on College Avenue and silently judged the parking jobs; Ramon Solano — caught themselves bragging a little about the neighborhood lately; Mateus Albuquerque — counted cranes on the skyline from the bus stop and got a different number than yesterday

Story seed 2666d3d5 (Downtown): Austin Reaves, Dexter Patel, Kwame Ellis, Mark Fisher — Austin Reaves — caught their reflection in a shop window and stood a little straighter; Dexter Patel — saw a stranger laugh at their phone and invented the joke all the way home; Kwame Ellis — watched the Anthropic shuttles roll into the Baylight District and wondered if the neighborhood was changing too fast; Mark Fisher — checked the Civis Systems Field livestream just to see if the grass had been laid down yet

Story seed 0329812a (Fruitvale): Sonia Parikh, Li Wei, Rick Walker, Rupert Ochoa — Sonia Parikh — closed their eyes during the choir solo and actually felt the tension leave their shoulders; Li Wei — stared at the Stabilization Fund application requirements until the numbers blurred together; Rick Walker — navigated the stroller traffic on College Avenue and silently judged the parking jobs near a taqueria patio; Rupert Ochoa — wondered if a decision from years back had been the right one near the station plaza

Story seed b07d88d2 (Uptown): Minka Slayton, Omar Amici, Coen Cartier, Janelle Rourke — Minka Slayton — walked through the alleyways behind Telegraph to avoid the weekend crowd; Omar Amici — the Oakland Alternative Response Initiative is making waves, with residents feeling safer and more connected than ever.; Coen Cartier — read the flyer about the Fruitvale Transit Hub delays and shook their head at the timeline; Janelle Rourke — saw someone running for the bus make it, and felt weirdly invested
